name: Customer Balance Report
sql_query:
SELECT
    c.Code                                         AS customer_code,
    c.name                                         AS customer_name,
    c.NIC                                          AS nic,
    c.phone,
    COALESCE(s.invoices, 0)                        AS open_invoices,
    COALESCE(s.sales_due, 0)                       AS sales_due,
    COALESCE(h.agreements, 0)                      AS open_agreements,
    COALESCE(h.hp_due, 0)                          AS hp_due,
    c.advance_balance                              AS advance_balance,
    COALESCE(s.sales_due, 0) + COALESCE(h.hp_due, 0) - c.advance_balance AS net_balance,
    LEAST(COALESCE(s.oldest_invoice, '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(h.oldest_agreement, '9999-12-31')) AS oldest_due_date
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_code,
           COUNT(*) AS invoices,
           SUM(Net_Amount - paid_amount - returned_amount) AS sales_due,
           MIN(Invoice_date) AS oldest_invoice
    FROM t_invoice_sums
    WHERE BC = :bc
      AND Net_Amount - paid_amount - returned_amount > 0.009
    GROUP BY customer_code
) s ON s.customer_code = c.Code
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_code,
           COUNT(*) AS agreements,
           SUM(outstanding_amount) AS hp_due,
           MIN(invoice_date) AS oldest_agreement
    FROM t_hire_purchase_sums
    WHERE BC = :bc
      AND status IN ('active', 'completed')
      AND outstanding_amount > 0.009
    GROUP BY customer_code
) h ON h.customer_code = c.Code
WHERE c.BC = :bc
  AND (:customer IS NULL OR c.Code = :customer)
  AND (:search   IS NULL OR c.Code  LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                         OR c.name  LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                         OR c.NIC   LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                         OR c.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%'))
  AND (
      :show = 'all'
      OR (COALESCE(:show, 'due') = 'due' AND COALESCE(s.sales_due, 0) + COALESCE(h.hp_due, 0) - c.advance_balance > 0.009)
      OR (:show = 'advance' AND c.advance_balance > 0.009)
  )
ORDER BY net_balance DESC, c.name;
